scientific_intent.scientific_task: Compute all batched pairwise Bray-Curtis dissimilarities and input gradients weighted by an incoming output gradient.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: D=sum_k|x_k-y_k|; S=sum_k|x_k+y_k|; d=D/S; gradients of sum_ij grad_output_ij*d_ij by signed quotient rule.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: Dense row-major featurevectors, unbatched or batched allpairs; no physicalmesh/PDE.
invariants: Gradient equals derivative of weighted dissimilarity on smoothnonzeroabsarguments; independent central differences for all56positivecase and1848signedcase scalarinputs.
accuracy_requirements: Fullfiniteoutputs: F32atol1e-5 rtol1e-4, F64atol1e-12 rtol1e-10; exact actualdevice inputprefix andguards.
Global dualbudget F32; per-field independentCPUchecks retain stricter F64budget. Relativeerror nearzero is interpreted together with absolutebudget.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Sequential sums/quotient gradient may round differently; nearzero derivatives amplify relativeerror, small denominators create illconditioning.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: SourcePyTorchpairwisefeaturecomparison/autograd API; no actualtrainingapplication or ecologicaldataset attribution established.
